_about: Circus costumes painted into a Rocketbox body's own picture by costume.py (rocketbox.py --costume <name>). Colours are sRGB hex. The flyers wear the player's look (circus-body.ts PLAYER_LOOK), the catcher his own (CATCHER_LOOK, built by art/v2/sirk/pose.py).

acrobat_partner._avatar: Sports_Male_01 (the one Rocketbox man in fitted swimwear, so nothing loose shows through the paint): a flyer beside the player, in her colours
